entries.aec5ed40d313ed40: Its management philosophy upholds contribution to the local community, sustainable growth of the company and respect for human resources. While securing procurement capability through closer cooperation with Tokyo Electric Power and advancing collaboration with companies in other industries, it has been evolving into a "comprehensive energy business" with LP gas as its main pillar and city gas and electricity as additional core businesses. Going forward, it aims to spread proposals for "optimal energy use" (NICIGAS3.0), which combine electricity and gas and use hybrid water heaters, storage batteries, solar panels and the like that can be controlled by AI and IoT, and to build a "comprehensive energy coordination capability" that goes beyond boundaries.
